purpose: Internal process-black separation rationale for explicitly reviewed neutral outline art
decision: An explicit black-only print separation is allowed only for neutral Outline or Black & White artwork. Four-channel DeviceCMYK is retained with zero C/M/Y. Colored sources and visible colored accents are rejected. This is a print-separation choice, not a color-art compression fallback.
unchanged: Independent PDF render matching and maximum byte gates
Default ICC-managed CMYK for color illustrations
validation: Exact channel checks and rejection tests for colored sources, tiny saturated accents, invalid styles and unknown separation modes.
